newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh minister resigns over private visit.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh minister resigns over private visit.

text.p: Bangladesh's State Minister for Local Government and Rural Development Syed Abul Hossain has resigned after he used a second passport on a recent private visit to Singapore, officials at the prime minister's office said on Monday.
They said the minister submitted his resignation letter on Sunday requesting Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to relieve him of his ministerial post.
The officials said the minister was summoned by Hasina on Sunday after he travelled to Singapore without government consent using his national green passport.

Bangladesh law dictates that when a minister takes oath he surrenders his green passport and obtains a red diplomatic passport. A minister cannot hold two passports and trips out of the country must be with government approval.
The officials said the minister had not given any reason for his resignation, which has not yet been accepted.
